packages.name: RTK Output Compression
packages.description: Rewrites bash commands through RTK for token-optimized command output.

review.notes: settings enabled (replaces RTK_DISABLED) and rewriteTimeoutMs (100 to 30000 ms, bounds one rtk rewrite) on top of 06276dff3688; permission exec unchanged (the extension runs the rtk binary through volt.exec and rewrites every bash command); version 0.3.0. Automated review (AI security-reviewer pass) in #674; squash-merged with the reviewed tree; awaiting maintainer review.

packages.author: Volt

packages.name: Terminal-Bench Harbor
packages.description: Runs Volt on Terminal-Bench through Harbor.

review.notes: settings model (ASCII provider/model pattern; reaches harbor -m as one argv entry and the rendered copy-paste command, whose PowerShell quoting now also doubles typographic single quotes), taskLimit, and concurrentTrials hold /tbench's defaults on top of 4fb0cd6af46d; /tbench asks with one form that can store them; the status uses a semantic token instead of ctx.ui.theme. Permissions unchanged: exec, network, fs-write, secrets (harbor through volt.exec; /tbench forwards ~/.volt/agent/auth.json and the agent directory into each Harbor environment); version 0.5.0. Automated review (AI security-reviewer pass) in #675; squash-merged with the reviewed tree; awaiting maintainer review.

packages.name: Azure DevOps
packages.description: Azure DevOps integration tools for Volt.

review.notes: settings organization (letters, digits, hyphens; also checked before each request so the PAT or token cannot reach another host), project, authMode, tenantId, and clientId (GUID) replace .volt/azure-devops.json on top of ab50b96c5595: no file writes, so fs-write is dropped (permissions network, secrets: Azure DevOps API calls, PAT and bearer tokens from the environment, device-code sign-in). /ado-config asks with one form; /ado-config save stores session values (default project scope, trusted projects only), never environment values; the device-code prompt is a card panel. Dependencies unchanged; version 0.3.0. Automated review (AI security-reviewer pass) in #676; squash-merged with the reviewed tree; awaiting maintainer review.

packages.name: Review Loop
packages.description: Runs isolated review/fix loops for a branch until findings are resolved.

review.notes: settings maxLoops and baseBranch (ref-name pattern, no leading dash; one git argv entry) on top of 128764c290ab; progress is a card panel instead of a string widget.
